info.name: NCBI Entrez E-utilities History Search API

params.name: db
params.description: Database to search. Common values: pubmed, pmc, gene, nucleotide, protein, assembly, biosample.

params.name: term
params.description: Entrez text query (URL encoded). Spaces may be replaced by '+' signs. Can include field tags like [Author] or [MeSH Terms].

params.name: retstart
params.description: Sequential index of the first UID in the retrieved set (default: 0).

params.name: retmax
params.description: Total number of UIDs to retrieve (default: 20, max: 100000).

params.name: rettype
params.description: Retrieval type. Values: uilist (default), count.

params.name: retmode
params.description: Response format. Values: xml (default), json.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order for results.

params.name: field
params.description: Limit search to specified field (e.g., Author, Title, MeSH Terms).

params.name: datetype
params.description: Type of date to limit the search. Values: mdat (modification date), pdat (publication date), edat (Entrez date).

params.name: reldate
params.description: Limit results to items published in the last n days.

params.name: mindate
params.description: Minimum date for date range filter (YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY/MM, or YYYY).

params.name: maxdate
params.description: Maximum date for date range filter (YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY/MM, or YYYY).

params.name: usehistory
params.description: Set to 'y' to store results on the Entrez History server for use in subsequent calls.

params.name: WebEnv
params.description: Web environment string returned from a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

params.name: query_key
params.description: Integer query key returned by a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

params.name: tool
params.description: Name of application making the call (no spaces). Recommended.

params.name: email
params.description: Contact email address. Recommended for NCBI to contact in case of problems.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key to enable up to 10 requests/second (vs 3 req/s without key).

items.docs: Performs a text query search in a single Entrez database and retrieves a list of matching UIDs (unique identifiers). Results can be stored on the Entrez History server for later use with other E-utilities.

params.name: db
params.description: Database to check spelling suggestions against.

params.name: term
params.description: Search term to check for spelling suggestions (URL encoded).

params.name: tool
params.description: Name of application making the call.

params.name: email
params.description: Contact email address.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

items.docs: Retrieves spelling suggestions for search terms in a given Entrez database.

info.name: EGQuery - Global search across all databases

params.name: term
params.description: Entrez search query (URL encoded).

params.name: tool
params.description: Name of application making the call.

params.name: email
params.description: Contact email address.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

items.docs: Performs a text query in all Entrez databases simultaneously and returns the number of results for the query in each database.

info.name: ECitMatch - Match citations to PubMed IDs

params.name: db
params.description: Only 'pubmed' is supported.

params.name: bdata
params.description: Citation strings formatted as: journal|year|volume|page|author|key|, separated by %0D (encoded newlines).

params.name: retmode
params.description: Response format (xml).

params.name: tool
params.description: Name of application making the call.

params.name: email
params.description: Contact email address.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

items.docs: Retrieves PubMed IDs (PMIDs) that correspond to a set of input citation strings. Each citation string must include journal, year, volume, page, author name, and a user-assigned key.
